S1037.reason: An assignee in an arm's-length transaction can enforce specific performance since the contract was assignable and the owner's refusal doesn't bar equitable relief.

S0107.reason: Personal immunity attaches to a person in their private capacity and does not cover conduct performed on behalf of the State.

S0341.reason: The normal adult respiratory rate is typically cited as 12-16 or 10-12, and among options A best fits standard textbook ranges.
